rule.description: Test-Driven Development is MANDATORY for all implementations. No production code may exist without a corresponding failing test written first.

phase.name: RED
phase.action: Write a failing test that describes the desired behavior
Run test via @test-runner — MUST SEE FAILURE before proceeding
phase.gate: Test MUST fail. If it passes immediately — rewrite the test.

phase.name: GREEN
phase.action: Write MINIMUM code to make the test pass
Run test via @test-runner — MUST SEE GREEN before proceeding
phase.gate: Only the minimum code needed. No extra features.

phase.name: REFACTOR
phase.action: Run ALL tests via @test-runner — ALL MUST STAY GREEN
phase.gate: All tests must remain green. No new features in this phase.

execution.rule: Always delegate test runs to @test-runner agent
Verbose output with full stack traces
Check test structure first before assuming code bugs

Cleanup after tests: Stop only the processes you started, by their PID. Never kill by name or pattern: other agents and CI jobs share the host, and a pattern kill sends them SIGTERM too (exit code 143, veracrew#2296). Example: npm test & pid=$!; wait "$pid" (or kill "$pid" if you must stop it)

violations.violation: Skipping RED phase — even for trivial code
Mock services in tests — use real implementations only
